strategy.primary: Cage toolbox: put cards with strong activated abilities into hand or graveyard (Entomb, Buried Alive, Faithless Looting), re-enter, blink or copy Mairsil to cage more, use haste and untaps for repeated tap abilities, and close with Mairsil-dependent activated-ability loops.
strategy.secondary: Exploit caged cards whose drawbacks aren't copied (Asmodeus draws seven cleanly) and grind with Arcanis, Pack Rat copies and Rings of Brighthearth.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Mairsil, the Pretender
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
When Mairsil enters, you may exile an artifact or creature card from your hand or graveyard and put a cage counter on it.
Mairsil has all activated abilities of all cards you own in exile with cage counters on them. You may activate each of those abilities only once each turn.

identity.why: Gains the activated abilities of every caged card.

Caged copy-maker for more cage triggers.
Untaps Mairsil for another tap ability.

cases.expected_claim_to_verify: Marvin gains Mairsil's caged activated abilities with the once-each-turn restriction. The source's no-restriction hypothesis is incorrect.
